'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Vikram Bali LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Vikram Bali]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Username:''' DVD ROTS
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
